title: TestTriageDiscardAndFixedByShortPrefix flakes on TempDir cleanup under -race
body:
In CI's go race job the test failed once: its TempDir cleanup found origin.git/objects not empty. Something the test started (a git process or a goroutine) is still writing into the fixture remote after the test returns. It passed on the next two runs. Flaky means a bug: the test, or the code it drives, has to wait for its writer before returning.
evidence: CI run 37393481229, job go race: testing.go:1464: TempDir RemoveAll cleanup: unlinkat .../TestTriageDiscardAndFixedByShortPrefix.../001/origin.git/objects: directory not empty
